official.publication: Palm-e: An embodied multimodal language model

summary.en: An embodied multimodal language model that connects sensor observations to language reasoning
summary.zh: 把传感器观察连接到语言推理的具身多模态语言模型

description.en:
PaLM-E extends a pretrained language model with continuous observations from vision and robotic sensors. Encoded images, robot states and other measurements are inserted into the same sequence as text, allowing one model to answer visual questions, describe scenes and support embodied planning.

The study shows positive transfer between robotics, vision-language and language tasks as the model scales, rather than treating each robot task as an isolated policy.
description.zh:
PaLM-E 把视觉与机器人传感器的连续观察接入预训练语言模型。编码后的图像、机器人状态和其他测量值与文本进入同一序列，使一个模型能够回答视觉问题、描述场景并支持具身规划。

研究显示，随着模型扩展，机器人、视觉语言与纯语言任务之间会产生正向迁移，而不是把每个机器人任务都视为孤立策略。

text.en: PaLM-E maps continuous sensor observations into embeddings that are interleaved with text tokens for a pretrained language model.
text.zh: PaLM-E 把连续传感器观察映射为嵌入，并与文本 token 交错输入预训练语言模型。

text.en: The paper reports positive transfer across embodied, vision-language and language tasks as model scale increases.
text.zh: 论文报告随着模型规模增加，具身、视觉语言与语言任务之间出现正向迁移。

html.en: Robotic learning systems often used task-specific policies, while large language models showed broad transfer across textual tasks. PaLM-E asked whether sensor observations could enter a language model directly so that embodied tasks share the same general-purpose reasoning substrate.
html.zh: 机器人学习系统往往使用任务专属策略，而大语言模型已经展示跨文本任务的广泛迁移。PaLM-E 追问：能否把传感器观察直接送入语言模型，让具身任务共享同一个通用推理基础。

html.en: Images and robot states are encoded as continuous embeddings and placed into a multimodal sentence alongside ordinary text tokens. The language model then predicts text that can express answers, plans or high-level decisions, while joint training mixes robotics data with vision-language and language tasks.
html.zh: 图像与机器人状态被编码为连续嵌入，并与普通文本 token 一起组成多模态句子。语言模型随后预测文本形式的答案、计划或高层决策，联合训练则混合机器人、视觉语言和纯语言任务。

html.en: Experts generally treat PaLM-E as an early large-scale bridge between embodied AI and multimodal language modeling. Its formulation influenced later vision-language-action systems by showing that robot observations and general web-scale knowledge can coexist inside one sequence model.
html.zh: 专家通常把 PaLM-E 视为具身 AI 与多模态语言建模之间较早的大规模桥梁。它证明机器人观察与网络规模通用知识可以共存于同一个序列模型中，并影响了后来的视觉语言动作系统。
